hero.title: How growth teams use an AI agent to capture better leads.
hero.body: Visitors ask a few questions and leave before filling in a form. These teams use Steps AI to collect details during the conversation and pass richer leads to sales.

stories.attribution: Ryan Collins | Growth Lead | Northstar SaaS
stories.excerpt: We were losing good inquiries because people would ask a few questions and leave without filling out the form. Now StepsAI gets the details while they’re already talking and passes the lead into our CRM with the conversation attached.

stories.attribution: Rachel Morgan | VP of Growth | LatticeFlow Labs
stories.excerpt: Our sales team has a lot more context before they speak to someone now. We can already see what they were asking about, what they’re trying to solve, company size, and sometimes which integrations matter to them. It makes the first call feel like a continuation of the conversation.

capabilities.title: What the AI lead capture agent does.

items.title: Collect details in the conversation

items.title: Save leads to your CRM

items.title: Give sales the context
items.body: Your team sees what the visitor asked about before the first call.
